memories.name: Imagine My Surprise
memories.objective: Spy on Hornigold and Rogers in Kingston, then find the Templar meeting at the east docks.
steps: Return to Kingston near coords 622, 169 and enter town with Adewale.
Speak to a contact at the building near 622, 168.
Head northeast to the lodgings of Hornigold and Rogers.
Enter through the hole in the nearby wall into tall grass beside an alarm bell.
Tag guards with Eagle Vision, whistle them into the grass one at a time and assassinate them, then sabotage the bell.
Go north along the western wall, avoiding cows, using bushes against wandering guards.
Climb the balcony on the east side of the nearby house to overhear Hornigold and Rogers.
Travel to the east docks warehouse near 625, 156; a gap in the western wall is an escape route.
Optionally sync the nearby Viewpoint to see guard positions.
For the stealthiest approach, keep to the southern edge by the water, climb over the roof and drop through a wall gap on the far side (cutscene).
Guards swarm afterwards; run and find cover to finish, no fighting needed.
tips: Tag guards with Eagle Vision before drawing them in.
Syncing the docks Viewpoint shows guard positions.
gaps: Contact's identity and what he says are not stated.

memories.name: Trust Is Earned
memories.objective: Sail to Principe, survive a Portuguese naval ambush, find Roberts and kill Burgess and Cockram.
steps: Optionally review Jackdaw upgrades first.
Sail to coords 939, 415 (border of Punta Guarico and Gibara) and use the marker to start.
Head for the next destination at 102, 38 on Principe.
Beat the five Portuguese ships (Frigates, Brigs, Cutters) that ambush you: approach slowly, use Mortars on ships behind rocks, take one side of the fleet at a time.
Disable Brigs rather than sinking them and board them to repair the Jackdaw.
Dock at Principe and go to the island's southern side; optionally climb the nearby boat and sync the Viewpoint to the right.
Follow the eastern treeline, assassinating guards one at a time from branches, then use the beam to Roberts' camp.
After talking to Roberts, go north to the small fort, pass the right-hand gate, climb the sandy watchtower and jump across branches into the central camp.
Take the letter in the central camp, which says Burgess is near the docks.
Head east (optionally sync the next Viewpoint), take down a gunner from the southern bushes and ramp, then leap from the Viewpoint into the bushes below.
Circle southeast over rooftops; a scene shows one target holding pirates captive.
Enter through the gap in the northeast fence, wait until both targets stand together beside a building, then double-assassinate them or ignite red barrels as they arrive.
tips: Brace when incoming fire is heavy.
Avoid orange circles, which mark incoming mortar fire.
Use islands to break line of sight if overwhelmed.
Clear nearby soldiers first to make the double assassination safer.
Keep the Jackdaw upgraded for the naval fight.
gaps: Viewpoint names and collectibles are not covered.
Specific Jackdaw upgrades are not listed (deferred to other guides).
After both targets die Edward returns to Roberts and the story jumps to September 1719; no further detail.
